messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-gateway-usw2 error rate > 3% (5xx spike). Alert ID PD-INC-9217. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx
alex.oncall: acked, I'll take this. :thumbsup:
maya.sre: looking now — seeing a rise in 502/503 from the proxy layer, kvcache miss rate spiking. Pulling logs.
chris.runtime: noted backend p95 latency jump ~16:42 UTC. Could be autoscaler churn + cache evictions on a hot prefix. Fetching metrics: https://dash.redwood/internal/metrics?panel=kv_miss
pagerduty-bot: Alert escalated to eng-sre after 2 unacks. Paging rotation: maya.sre -> alex.oncall -> chris.runtime.
alex.oncall: quick triage plan: 1) shift some traffic off inference-gateway-usw2 2) scale dedicated pool +2 nodes 3) enable fallback model variant (v1.9) for latency-sensitive routes. Executing now.
maya.sre: running scale command, will post command + output:
```
# scale inference pool
kubectl -n inference-scale set replicas gpupool-usw2 6 --record
# warming caches
./tools/warm_kv_cache --pool gpupool-usw2 --prefix /chat
```
chris.runtime: starting traffic slice reroute to us-east by +10% (weight adjust). Command: `trafficctl route adjust --from=usw2 --to=use1 --weight=10`
dennis.support: any immediate customer impact? I'm seeing a handful of 502s tied to a high-traffic enterprise tenant in EU beginning ~16:40. Do we need an external comms draft?
alex.oncall: yes, please draft a short status: "Investigating elevated error rates impacting inference requests in US-W2, mitigation underway." Dennis please post on status if we see >5% customer error rate.
maya.sre: pool scaled +2, nodes accepted, cache warmers running. KV miss rate starting to drop.
chris.runtime: reroute applied, confirmed traffic shift +10% to use1. Observability shows 5xx tail starting to reduce.
prod-ops: recommend temporary client backoff for heavy streaming clients for 30m to reduce amplification. Approve?
alex.oncall: approved, push rate-limit backoff for top 5 heavy clients.
prod-ops: patch applied.
alex.oncall: keeping thread open; will post updates every 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
pagerduty-bot: Automated update: 5xx rate decreased from 3.8% -> 1.2% over last 5m. Alert PD-INC-9217 auto-cleared at 1755551388.
maya.sre: monitoring for another 10-15m; KV miss stable.
dennis.support: status page updated: "Mitigation in progress, error rate decreasing. No major customer impact identified; teams are scaling and rerouting traffic."
alex.oncall: thanks all — follow-ups: retro to capture autoscaler hysteresis + add cache warming job to rollout. Wrapping this up unless we see regressions.
chris.runtime: logging runbook notes and commands used. Will open a follow-up ticket for canary traffic smoothing.
prod-ops: noted.
alex.oncall: closing in 10m if stable. :white_check_mark:
